[USER] User is thinking of setting up a shrimp tank.  
[USER] User is interested in the ideal water temperature for cherry shrimp.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The ideal water temperature for cherry shrimp is between 65°F to 75°F (18°C to 24°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cherry shrimp can tolerate a temperature range of 59°F to 79°F (15°C to 26°C) for short periods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For breeding, the optimal temperature is 68°F to 72°F (20°C to 22°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For growth, the optimal temperature is 72°F to 75°F (22°C to 24°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For general keeping, the recommended temperature is 65°F to 70°F (18°C to 21°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is essential to maintain a stable temperature to avoid stressing the shrimp.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should invest in a good quality aquarium heater and thermometer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should avoid placing the tank near drafts, air conditioning vents, or direct sunlight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should research specific water parameters for cherry shrimp, including pH, hardness, and water changes.  
[USER] User asks for the recommended water hardness and pH range for cherry shrimp.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cherry shrimp thrive in soft to moderately hard water with a slightly acidic to neutral pH.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended water hardness (GH & KH): General Hardness (GH): 4-10 dGH; Carbonate Hardness (KH): 1-4 dKH.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Preferred GH around 5-7 dGH and KH around 1-2 dKH.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended pH range: 6.5-7.5; Ideal pH: 6.8-7.2.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cherry shrimp can tolerate a pH range of 6.0-8.0, but thrive in a slightly acidic to neutral pH.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] A pH above 7.5 can lead to stress and health issues for the shrimp.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other water parameters include temperature (65°F-75°F or 18°C-24°C), moderate to low water flow, and regular water changes (10-20% every week).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should use a water conditioner
